name: instance_who_am_i_grpc_web
about: A successful authenticated unary call: the principal the auth layer admitted. `loams dev` with auth off admits a loopback caller as the `dev-loopback` principal (#436), so this answers rather than refusing. `not_implemented` is recorded from the apps mock instead. (gRPC-Web, the framing a browser sends. One length-prefixed frame: flag 0 and a zero-length message.)
